description: Per-agent capability-shaped assessment (A1-A5) against one or more AI governance frameworks. Returns obligations + gaps + runtime-control recommendations + Stack L1-L5 heatmap. Different from `audit_ai_governance` (full-framework checklist) and `evaluate_project_compliance` (project routing) — this is per-agent + capability-shaped. For banned-category screening use `audit_ai_red_lines`.

agentId.description: Stable identifier for the agent (used in output metadata).

capabilitiesInUse.description: Subset of A1-A5 that the agent design actually exercises.

jurisdiction.description: One or more framework codes/aliases. Valid codes: JAPAN, HIROSHIMA-ICOC, EU-AIA, KOREA, CAIDP-UG, UNESCO-RAM, MGF-AGENTIC, AI-GOVERNANCE-STACK. Aliases include IMDA→MGF-AGENTIC, STACK→AI-GOVERNANCE-STACK, etc.

toolsetDescription.description: Free-text description of MCP tools / external systems / APIs the agent calls (used for A2 evidence).

name: assess_agent_capability
